an8.29:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] khaṇakicco loko khaṇakicco lokoti bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano bhāsati, no ca kho so jānāti khaṇaṃ vā akkhaṇaṃ vā.
an8.29:1.4: idha bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammā sambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā. dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāyiko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito,
an8.29:1.5: ayaṃ ca puggalo nirayaṃ upapanno hoti.
an8.29:1.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā. dhammo ca desīyati …pe… sugatappavedito,
an8.29:2.2: ayañca puggalo tiracchānayoniṃ upapanno hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… dhammo ca desīyati …pe…
an8.29:3.2: ayañca puggalo pettivisayaṃ upapanno hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… dhammo ca desīyati …pe…
an8.29:4.2: ayañca puggalo aññataraṃ dīghāyukaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapanno hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… dhammo ca desīyati …pe…
an8.29:5.2: ayañca puggalo paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti aviññātāresu milakkhesu. yattha natthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ. ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… dhammo ca desīyati …pe… ayaṃñca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti micchādiṭṭhiko viparītadassano
an8.29:6.2: natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ natthi hutaṃ natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko natthi paro loko natthi mātā natthi pitā natthi sattā opapātikā natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti. ayaṃ bhikkhave chaṭṭho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe…
an8.29:7.2: dhammo ca desīyati …pe… ayaṃñca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo elamūgo. na paṭibalo subhāsita dubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ.
an8.29:7.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave sattamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke anuppanno hoti arahaṃ sammā sambuddho …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
an8.29:8.2: dhammo ca na desīyati opasamiko parinibbāyiko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito, ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsita dubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ.
an8.29:8.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:9.1: ime kho bhikkhave, aṭṭha akkhaṇā asamayā brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:10.1: ekova bhikkhave, khaṇo ca samayo ca brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:10.3: idha bhikkhave, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
an8.29:10.4: dhammo ca desīyati opasamiko parinibbāyiko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsita dubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ.
an8.29:10.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave, ekova khaṇo ca samayo ca brahmacariyavāsāyāti.
